282768703.description: This lot includes two natural mineral specimens perfect for collectors. The first piece is a polished blue agate geode slice featuring a crystalline druzy center with banded blue, white, and dark quartz formations and a flat base for upright display. The second specimen is a raw matrix rock displaying a cluster of natural white and cream-colored crystal formations embedded in a gray stone base with natural jagged crystal points. Both specimens are in good display condition and showcase authentic geological formations ideal for mineral and gemstone enthusiasts.
